import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy import ndimage,signal
from extract import add,s

def maskcolors(im):
 r,g,b=[im[:,:,i].astype(float) for i in range(3)]
 return [(r<180)&(g<180)&(b<180),(r>170)&(g<210)&(b>170),(r<210)&(g>170)&(b>170),(r<210)&(g>170)&(b<210)]
y,x=np.mgrid[-5:6,-5:6]
rad=np.sqrt(x*x+y*y)
shapes=[(abs(rad-3.5)<.7),(np.abs(y-3)<.75)&(abs(x)<4) | (abs(y-(2*abs(x)-3.5))<.75)&(abs(x)<4)&(y<3.5),((np.maximum(abs(x),abs(y))>=2.5)&(np.maximum(abs(x),abs(y))<=3.5)),(abs(abs(x)+abs(y)-4)<.75)]
for n in [47,49]:
 im=Image.open(f'images/fig_{n:03}.png').convert('RGB'); ar=np.asarray(im)
 masks=maskcolors(ar);d=ImageDraw.Draw(im);ss=[]
 for i,(mask,shape) in enumerate(zip(masks,shapes)):
  kern=shape.astype(float);kern/=kern.sum()
  bg=(~shape).astype(float);bg/=bg.sum()
  score=signal.correlate2d(mask.astype(float),kern-.65*bg,mode='same')
  # choose maxima with one peak for each glyph, including overlapping glyphs
  peaks=(score==ndimage.maximum_filter(score,size=(5,5)))&(score>.32)
  if n==47:
   peaks[:1]=False;peaks[335:]=False;peaks[:,:149]=False;peaks[:,747:]=False
   peaks[:150,550:]=False
  else:
   peaks[:30]=False;peaks[345:]=False;peaks[:,:116]=False;peaks[:,681:]=False
   peaks[:160,490:]=False
   peaks[:80,:145]=False
  yy,xx=np.where(peaks)
  candidates=sorted(zip(score[yy,xx],xx,yy),reverse=True)
  pp=[]
  for v,px,py in candidates:
